title: What Climate Art Commissions Is
definition: Climate Art Commissions: commissions making climate visible.
description:
Climate Art Commissions is commissions making climate visible. It sits squarely in Future Art, Design & Fashion, the frontier where climate datasets science becomes commission logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are public space-scale. Societies that master commission hulls early will shape impact measurement practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why climate datasets programs worldwide now treat Climate Art Commissions as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Climate Art Commissions needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Climate Art Commissions
definition: Estimates Climate Art Commissions readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Climate Art Commissions components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a commission hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Climate Art Commissions Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Climate Art Commissions operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Climate Art Commissions installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 73165 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where climate datasets monitoring, commission logistics redundancy, or impact measurement maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Climate Art Commissions Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Climate Art Commissions: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Climate Art Commissions — commissions making climate visible.

Phase 1 — Prove (climate datasets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (commission logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (impact measurement): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (public space): commission hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
